grounding.states: Pineapple on pizza is a matter of taste, with no rule or safety issue against it
grounding.from: Whether pineapple on pizza is "ok" is a matter of taste. The search results contain no rule or safety issue against it.

grounding.states: In the newest poll found, YouGov March 2023, about 59% of Americans like or love pineapple on pizza
grounding.from: YouGov poll, March 2023: 22% of Americans love pineapple on pizza, 37% like it... By this poll, a majority (about 59%) like or love it.

grounding.states: In a 2017 Slice app survey, 54% said pineapple does not belong on pizza
grounding.from: Slice app survey, 2017: 54% of respondents said pineapple does not belong on pizza.

value.answer: Totally fine, it's just taste, nothing wrong with it. People are really split on it though. The newest poll I found (YouGov, March 2023) had about 59% of Americans liking or loving it, but a 2017 Slice survey had 54% saying it doesn't belong. So it's a love-it-or-hate-it topping, and you're in good company either way.
